movelist.name: Sucker Punch
movelist.effect: If an adjacent foe targets the user with a Damaging Attack, Sucker Punch may be used as an Interrupt Move against the triggering foe.

movelist.name: Embargo
movelist.effect: The target cannot use or benefit from held items for the remainder of the encounter. Embargo may only affect one target at a time; if Embargo is used on a new target, the previous target is freed from the effect.

movelist.name: Shadow Ball
movelist.effect: Shadow Ball lowers the foe’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+.

movelist.name: Curse
movelist.effect: If the user is not a Ghost Type, Curse has a Frequency of EOT, and when used the user lowers its Speed by -1 Combat Stage, but raises Attack and Defense by +1 Combat Stage each.  If the user is a Ghost Type, Curse has a Frequency of Scene, and when used the user loses 1/3rd of their Max Hit Points and a target Pokémon or Trainer within 8 meters of the user becomes Cursed. This Hit Point loss cannot be prevented in any way.

movelist.name: Hex
movelist.effect: Once a Scene, if Hex’s target has a Status Affliction, you may have Hex’s Damage Base be 13 instead (4d10+10 / 35).

abilities.name: Insomnia
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the Sleep condition, and cannot use the move Rest. Defensive.

abilities.name: Cursed Body
abilities.trigger: The user is hit by a Damaging Move.

abilities.name: Voodoo Doll
abilities.trigger: The user uses the Move Curse as a Ghost Type
abilities.effect: Connection - Curse. Choose an additional target within 8 meters of the user to become Cursed.
